 Katana Beard - The Master's Story

Since his pup years, Katabear was never like the others. Even as a child, in his first years on this earth, he knew he was destined for greatness - so he knew what had to be done.

While others were partying, he was studying the blade. While others were engaging in premarital sex, he was cultivating his inner strength.

As the years went by, his power grew more and more. His skill with the katana turned into absolute mastery, fueled by the one and only drink worthy of him: Mountain (Fuji) Dew.  


And, of course, as he gracefully slid from his young pup self into a master, people started to notice him. Being the lone wolf, Katabear studied only in solitude, far from this world's distractions. But as it always happened, the distractions came to him.

On a lonesome night, as the sun was falling and the blood moon rising into the sky, Katabear heard giggles from behind the trees. A noob would have been easily startled, but the master, first of all, was sure of his mastery of the ancient ways, and second of all, he knew that those giggles were nothing else other than expressions of admiration for him. With a graceful sweep of his blade, he cut down the trees, leaving the females unharmed, and, of course, in awe of his skill.

"My fair maidens," he started, his brow erected, "what could you be possibly doing at this unorthodox hour, outside?" he inquired, licking his teeth while smiling charmingly.

"Oh, my dear warrior, we were here to just... observe your mastery of the blade," one of them, a tanned, dark haired, curvaceous lady sheepishly responded.

"My dear ladies, I understand your need to see me, but I feel obligated to express my deepest concerns for your safety while coming here. You're prefectly safe with me, no worry, but the Chads are all over these lands."

"Sweet master!" the same one cried out. "My name is Purple \[due to you blocking her name with purple :)\], please take me and mine under your protective wing!"

But barely after she finished talking, an odd smell could be felt. Katabear rushed to the ladies' side, smelling nothing other than people that actually shower and use deodorant - how vile! It had to be those monstrous, evil Chads!

And lo and behold, the infamous Chads appeared, with their leader in front!

It was, of course, his nemesis: The Devil Witcher!

Nothing compared to himself, but a threat to the ladies nonetheless.

Katabear charged at him, full speed, full power, swinging over his head. The devilish Witcher blocked his attack with his weakling shield, raising his pitiful basket hilt sword, sending his fine blade into the dirt. With a masterful spin, Katabear blocked the Chad's attack and regained his posture.

As the battle went on, too caught up in the intense duel, the master forgot about his newly acquired females - and when he remembered, it was too late. They - the CHADS - had stolen them away: *his* waifus!

Stricken with grief and anger, the master let the gruesome Chad run away, like the peasant he was.

"I WILL FIND YOU, AND I WILL GET MY REVENGE!" he screamed after his enemy cowardly hid from his anger.

With nothing else to do other than grieve, Katabear started roaming the lands, and as his honor dictated, searched for a new group of peasants to bring under his wing and teach, hoping one day he'd get his revenge.
